definitions.gloss: permanent; standing; regular; always set up
definitions.explanation: Describes facilities, exhibitions, or organizations that exist on a permanent or ongoing basis, as opposed to temporary ones.

examples.japanese: {常設|じょうせつ}{展示|てんじ}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see the permanent exhibition.

examples.japanese: この{施設|しせつ}には{常設|じょうせつ}のカフェがある。
examples.english: This facility has a permanent cafe.

examples.japanese: {常設|じょうせつ}{委員会|いいんかい}が{設置|せっち}され、{定期的|ていきてき}に{会議|かいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれている。
examples.english: A standing committee was established and meetings are held regularly.

notes:
USAGE:
Used as a noun or as a no-adjective modifier ({常設|じょうせつ}の). Also used as a suru verb in the sense of establishing something permanently ({常設|じょうせつ}する).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常設|じょうせつ}{展示|てんじ} (permanent exhibition)
- {常設|じょうせつ}{委員会|いいんかい} (standing committee)
- {常設|じょうせつ}{店舗|てんぽ} (permanent shop)

CONTRAST:
- {臨時|りんじ}: temporary, ad hoc — the opposite concept
- {仮設|かせつ}: temporary, provisional — used for temporary structures
